verdict.rationale: Alma states an employer-facing program: a 'Growth' pricing tier for 26-250 foreign nationals offering 'visibility and control,' a system that 'keeps every case moving, flags risk early' with visibility at every step, and a claim of under an hour per week to manage the entire program. It also offers business demos and positions itself as a firm 'for companies and individuals,' which goes beyond single founder cases. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the multi-case dashboard or portal features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the company program.
